subject: Downtime window confirmation + proportional credit split proposal
messages:
From: Alex Byrne <alex@pinegrove.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: account-team@pinegrove.com, Pinegrove Billing <billing@pinegrove.com>
Date: 2028-07-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Production interruption affecting checkout (07/25) — request for downtime confirmation and credit eligibility

Hi Marissa,

We saw a significant interruption of checkout traffic between 08:23:14 and 08:49:57 PDT on July 25th. Our metrics show ~14% failed authorizations and a 12x increase in 5xx responses during that window which materially affected our flash-sale conversion.

Can you confirm Redwood's observed downtime window and advise whether this qualifies for an SLA credit? I attached a short impact spreadsheet.

Attachments: pinegrove-impact-summary.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — we appreciate a quick confirmation so we can communicate to our ops and finance teams.

— Alex Byrne
Senior Ops Manager, Pinegrove Commerce
alex@pinegrove.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Byrne <alex@pinegrove.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-25T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production interruption affecting checkout (07/25) — request for downtime confirmation and credit eligibility

Alex — thanks for flagging this and for the impact file. We opened incident RED-2028-07-25-1124 and I'm looping in Diego (SRE) and Karthik (Customer Success) to validate the telemetry and next steps.

Immediate plan:
- Diego will pull the runtime traces and confirm the exact availability window we observed.
- We'll reconcile tenant-level impact and determine whether proportional credits apply given the multi-tenant routing during the window.
- I'll follow up with a proposed credit allocation and invite execs to a short postmortem within 48 hours.

Can you confirm whether Pinegrove saw any client-side retries that correlate with the 08:23 timestamp? Also please keep billing on copy for credit processing.

Thanks,

— Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Byrne <alex@pinegrove.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-25T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production interruption affecting checkout (07/25) — preliminary timeline and evidence request

Marissa / Alex — preliminary findings attached. Short summary:
- Infra telemetry shows a spike in scheduler preemptions and a KV cache eviction storm starting 08:22:58 PDT that caused increased tail latency and 502/503 responses.
- There was a short maintenance job in the us-west-2 pool (rolling kernel update) that overlapped with elevated autoscaler churn. Noted overlap: 08:20–08:28 PDT (maintenance), eviction storm 08:22:58–08:47:10 PDT.
- Tenant routing indicates ~65% of affected requests during the spike were routed to a noisy hardware host; Pinegrove requests were distributed across 3 shards, with estimated impacted percent ~38% of your total requests in the window.

Attachments: prod-logs-20280725.tar.gz (log bundle), kv-evictions-20280725.csv (eviction deltas), prelim-incident-timeline.pdf

Next actions I propose:
1) We validate exact request-attribution using your tenant id 67890 (Alex — confirm if this is the correct id).
2) If attribution confirms partial exposure (~38%), propose a proportional credit calculation (per our SLA: credit percentage = impacted-requests/total-requests for the billing period slice).
3) Schedule a 30-minute postmortem with Pinegrove execs + Redwood SRE + Legal to review timeline and credit mechanics.

I can produce a compact evidence bundle for legal. Diego
— Diego Fernandez
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Byrne <alex@pinegrove.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Pinegrove Billing <billing@pinegrove.com>, account-team@pinegrove.com
Date: 2028-07-25T12:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production interruption affecting checkout (07/25) — acknowledgement and request for postmortem + DocuSign credit form

Diego — thanks for the early analysis. Tenant id confirmed: 67890. The attribution you estimated aligns with our internal sampling.

We accept a proportional approach — but we need: (a) an executive postmortem with concrete mitigation steps, (b) a firm credit amount and timetable for settlement, and (c) a DocuSign or equivalent statement we can route to Finance.

Proposed times for the postmortem: 07/26 10:00–10:30 PDT or 07/27 15:00–15:30 PDT. Please confirm availability and note Pinegrove will have the CFO on the call for approval of the credit.

Also, please include any ACL/trace snippets that show request hashes so we can match against our side.

— Alex
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Byrne <alex@pinegrove.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-27T16:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production interruption affecting checkout (07/25) — meeting confirmed and action items

Alex — thanks, confirmed. We're booked for 07/27 15:00–15:30 PDT (calendar invite sent). Attendees: Pinegrove (Alex Byrne, CFO), Redwood (Marissa, Diego, Karthik), and Legal (Laura).

Action items before the call:
- Diego: finalize evidence bundle with request hashes and share Drive link. (prod-logs-20280725.tar.gz, kv-evictions-20280725.csv, prelim-incident-timeline.pdf)
- Laura: draft proportional credit statement and DocuSign template reflecting our SLA formula and the proposed impacted fraction (38%).
- Karthik: prepare a concise customer-facing note that explains the credit calculation and next steps for invoicing.

Links: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/sre/pinegrove/incident-20280725
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

We'll aim to have a final credit figure and a signed DocuSign within 5 business days after the meeting, barring any new evidence. If anyone needs the meeting moved, let me know within the hour.

Best,

— Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
